organization_id.description: Canonical Organization record ID pinned to this pricing schedule.

pricing_schedule_id.description: PlatformPricingSchedule record assigned to this organization.

pricing_schedule_key_snapshot.description: Copied pricing_schedule_key retained for readable historical billing records.

assignment_status.description: Lifecycle of this organization's pricing-schedule assignment. Only one active assignment should exist per organization.

effective_at.description: When this pricing schedule begins controlling new charges for the organization.

ended_at.description: When this schedule stopped controlling new charges for the organization.

organization_plan_subscription_id.description: Optional current OrganizationPlanSubscription record connected to this pricing assignment.

assignment_source.description: How the organization was assigned to this pricing schedule.

assigned_by_user_id.description: Platform user who created the assignment, when applicable.

change_reason.description: Required internal explanation when an organization moves from one pricing schedule to another.

notes.description: Internal notes for grandfathering, contract terms, or approved exceptions.
